build_transformer_config: build a TransformerConfig dataclass with embed dim, num heads, head dim, and attention types for a Gemma model
create_attention_layer_pattern: create an attention layer pattern by calling make_attention_layers_types with a pattern tuple and num_layers count
init_transformer_cache: initialize a transformer cache by calling init_cache on a TransformerConfig with batch size and cache length
query_pre_attn_scalar: compute the query pre-attention scalar value from a TransformerConfig using the query_pre_attn_scalar method
use_gemma3_attention_pattern: use the GEMMA3_ATTENTION_PATTERN constant to configure alternating global and local sliding attention layers
